name: link_path
title: Read the value of a symbolic link

origin.description: Read the value of a symbolic link

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character vector of one or more paths.

origin.details: Read the value of a symbolic link
origin.value: A tidy path to the object the link points to.
origin.example:
.old_wd <- setwd(tempdir())
file_create("foo")
link_create(path_abs("foo"), "bar")
link_path("bar")

# Cleanup
file_delete(c("foo", "bar"))
setwd(.old_wd)
